notes.title: BIGGEST UPDATE EVER CREATED?
notes.content:
Hello drivers.

We are finally happy to bring our new overhauled version to public.

We are now again updating the game weekly and even have experimental android version working.

New maps, modes and cars soon!

Changes in this and last version are too far apart.
Graphics have been overhauled.
Network engine changed and complete network recode.
Many more things.

Thank you everyone who purchased our game so far.

notes.title: Out of Early Access update
notes.content:
Hello drivers!

Unfortunately due to changes in our team, this update took a long time!

We have added so many new things that it is very hard to list them all here.

You can check our new trailer from our steam store page to see this update in action!

Updates:
- 33 Player King of the Road mode that spans multiple maps, last one remaining or first in the end wins the game!
- King of the Road also has leaderboards, let's see who is the best ;)
- Most of the old code has been reprogrammed to get rid of bugs that had been an issue with the game for a long time.
- New materials, VFX and graphics all around the game.
- Controls have been redone so player can have as complete control of the car as possible.

Thanks for all the support and have fun! :)

Lot of more content coming soon!

Please report any bugs ;)

notes.title: Summer Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello Drivers!

We have now released a hotfix to fix few more major issues in the game.

The most critical one was that you could start online game alone without any other players.

This is now fixed.

We will bring more updates very soon!

notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content:
Hello drivers! Unfortunately due to changes in our team, the update took longer than expected.
We have added so many new things, some will probably be missing from this list.

[b]Updates:[/b]
[*]Game now uses a new rendering pipeline and has much better graphics.
[*] 2 new cars: Tierra Blaze and Titan Z1
[*] New Racing Map: Floating Island
[*] New HotShot game mode map: Skyroof, has Golden Railgun which you can use to destroy enemies with a single shot!
[*] New main menu features: car coloring, car selection, and various other fixes and improvements.
[*] New song in the main menu.
[*] Improved Online Lobby.
[*] Racing Map on Local Play now has AI drivers so you can also play by yourself.
[*] Clients leaving the match no longer take everyone back to the lobby, instead it allows for the race to proceed.
[*] Skybeam weapon has been improved.
[*] Much improved Space Plate level.
[*] Much improved Doomsday racing level.
[*] Racing maps Lost City and Winter Zone are being remastered and will be added back shortly.
[*] New visual effects for many of the weapons.
[*] Oil now gets activated quicker.
[*] Railgun now has bigger hitbox.
[*] Various checkpoint bugs have been fixed.
[*] Various sanity checks all around the place to prevent weird behavior and crashes.
[*] New Round / Game winner animated banners.
[*] Currently the game can only be played on Windows x64 with Direct X12. (Mac and Vulkan are still too unstable.)
[*] Improved Voting Screen.
[*] And many more things we have forgotten.
[/ul]

notes.title: April 21st Update
notes.content:
Hello drivers! We are happy to announce that the third update is available now.

This current update includes various improvements, fixes and features.

Such as:
- Fixes and improvements for Winterzone and SpacePlate.
- Voice Overs for Weapons on Multiplayer.
- New map, Doomsday, with so many new twists and turns, be sure not to fall off the track!
- General gameplay improvements.
- Fixes for sounds in certain areas.
- New Track Selector for Local Play.
- New UI for Gameplay.
- Graphical fixes for UI.
- UI Color changes for every aspect of the game.
- New Itembox Design.
- UI changes to Main Menu.

And much more.

The next Major Update will be May 5th, which will include more fixes such as:
- New Gamemode HotShot, a game mode where one shot means certain death.
- New Cars.
- New Score System.
- More UI Changes.
- More surprises.

Stay focused on the road drivers, cause there is a lot of updates coming ahead, and thank you all for the support you've given!

notes.title: April 7th Update
notes.content:
Hello drivers! We are happy to announce that the second update is available now.

This current update includes various improvements and fixes.

Such as:
- Major UI Changes and improvements in numerous places, such as main menu, lobby, and even in game.
- Track changes, such as changes to Winterzone and Space Plate.
- Better hover effects for items in menu, so it's more clearly visible.
- Improvements for collision of itemboxes.
- More sounds, to tracks like space plate and shrinking space plate.
- New Track Selector for Multiplayer.
- Tweaks and improvements to weapons.

And much more.

The next Major Update will be April 21st, which will include more fixes such as:
- Doomsday Track.
- More UI Changes.
- Voice overs and car visual improvements.

And much more.

Stay focused on the road drivers, cause there is a lot of updates coming ahead, and thank you all for the support you've given!

notes.title: March 24th Update
notes.content:
Hello drivers! We are happy to announce that first update is available now.

This current update includes various improvements and fixes.

Such as:
- Level fixes, such as winterzone artifact at the starting position.
- Map changes, such as Arena redesign and renaming to Shrinking Space Plate, and a new map, Space Plate.
- Map Presenter fixed for Winter Zone and Arena.
- Spectate ongoing match.
- New and improved player zoom, on match/round end. So you can see their cars.
- Better hover effects for items in menu, so it's more clearly visible.
- Improved oil and mine cleanup on character spawns.
- Optimized checkpoint colliders.
- Fixes for sidebooster effect when input is unpressed.
- Fix for double music on winterzone map.
- Fixes for when hosts disconnects.
- Fixes for visible score appearance weirdness with more players.

And much more.

The next Major Update will be April 7th, which will include more fixes such as:
- Numerous weapon fixes.
- Numerous level fixes, such as scaling space plate based on player count.
- Map Presenter fix for Space Plate and Shrinking Space Plate.
- More UI changes in an effort to make a thematic design.

And much more.

Stay focused drivers, cause there is a lot of updates coming ahead, and thank you all for the support you've given!
